summary: Connect to an existing OPNsense router for candidate read-only status without changing its configuration or ownership.

inputs.description: An explicitly approved private IP-literal HTTPS OPNsense origin.
An API key and secret supplied through protected local credential storage.
An explicitly enrolled PEM certificate for a router not trusted by system roots.

privileges.description: Constrained upstream API privileges and deny-config-write on the exact tested release.

dependencies.description: A separately operated OPNsense router at the approved origin.

fields.name: credential_ref
fields.description: Controller-owned protected reference to API credential and optional enrolled certificate.

provenance.version_policy: The external owner chooses the installed version; Cozy SOC's candidate API accepts only 26.7.4 until an owned lab validates more versions.

data_handling.activation: Connection setup reads version state after deliberate approval. A separate exact-scope foreground approval reads ARP/NDP tables once; no background polling or external settings change.
sources: Approved external OPNsense system-information GET endpoint. Separately approved bounded ARP/NDP GET endpoints for one enrolled network scope.
stored: External ownership, approved origin, protected credential reference and redacted control audit records. In-scope router-reported IP/MAC/interface evidence with ephemeral retention and content-free collection audits.
excluded: API credentials or enrolled certificate in ordinary configuration and diagnostics, neighbor tables during setup, out-of-scope neighbors, router hostnames, and all router configuration changes.
